# Stoic

> Robustness primitives for Swift apps (Swift 6.4, Apple platforms 27+): deadlines, retry, scopes, structured concurrency helpers, state machines, supervision, service graphs, structured errors, strict JSON and schema validation, and test tooling. Plain async functions over Swift concurrency; typed errors pass through.

Products: `Stoic` (runtime), `StoicTesting` (test clocks, faults, trait), `StoicJSON` (strict parser), `StoicSchema` (validation).

## Time
- `withTimeout(_ duration:) { … }` / `withDeadline(_ deadline:) { … }`: cooperative; operation runs as a child task inheriting the caller's actor; result must be Sendable; error passes through. `Deadline.current` narrows, never widens.
- `abandoningAfter(_ duration:, label:, limit:) { syncWork() }`: for uncancellable blocking work; runs on Dispatch; throws `PolicyError.rejected(.deadlineExceeded)`; a label never occupies more than `limit` threads, running or abandoned; refuses with `.abandonmentLimit` once every slot is abandoned.
- `CancellationCause.current`: `.deadline`, `.userRequested`, `.superseded`, `.siblingFailed`, `.scopeEnded`, `.supervisorStopped`, `.stateExited`.
- `Ambient.sleep(for:)`: sleep on the ambient (injectable) clock.

## Retry
- `retry(.exponential(base: .milliseconds(200)).attempts(5)) { attempt in … }`: schedule must be bounded (`.attempts(n)`); budget per call site on by default; nested retries make one attempt; never past the deadline; rethrows the last error.
- `retry(_:attemptTimeout:) { … }`: each attempt bounded; timed-out attempts are retried.
- `Schedule`: `.fixed`, `.linear`, `.exponential` (jittered, capped 5 min by default), `.fibonacci`, `.decorrelated`, `.delays([…])`; `.capped(at:)`, `.jittered()`, `.unjittered()`, `.upTo(elapsed:)`, `.union`, `.intersection`, `.andThen`, `.attempts(n)` → `BoundedSchedule` (`maximumAttempts`, `worstCase(attemptTimeout:)`).
- `Retryable` (errors classify themselves: `.retry`, `.retryAfter(d)`, `.stop`), `RetryClassifier.standard/.transientOnly/.never`, `RetryBudget.perCallSite/.named(_)/.unlimited`, `RetryNesting.singleAttempt/.allow`.
- `recur(_ schedule:) { attempt in .continue / .continueAfter(d) / .stop }` → `RecurOutcome`.

## Concurrency
- `TaskSlot<S, F>(label:)`: `.run { … } deliver: { @MainActor result in … }` (only newest delivers, on the caller's actor; annotate the closure to touch actor state), `.runExclusively`, `.cancel()`.
- `race(a, b[, c, d])` or `race([Racer { … }])`: first success; losers cancelled and awaited.
- `mapConcurrent(items, limit: n) { … }`, `mapConcurrentResults`.
- `AsyncSemaphore(permits:label:).withPermit { … }`, `AsyncMutex(label:).withLock { … }`: FIFO, cancellation/deadline aware; throw `PolicyError`.
- `SingleFlight<K, V, F>(label:).run(key) { … }`: shared execution, refcounted cancellation.
- `Channel<T>(capacity:, overflow: .suspend/.dropOldest/.dropNewest/.reject, label:)`: bounded; `send`, `trySend`, `receive`, `finish`, `for await`.

## Scopes
- `withScope { scope in let r = try await scope.acquire { … } release: { r, exit in … } }`: LIFO release on success/failure/cancel; shielded; bounded by `exitBudget`/`finalizerTimeout`.
- `Resource(label:acquire:release:)`, `scope.onExit { exit in … }`.
- `withTaskScope { scope in scope.fork(label:) { … } }`: forks cancelled/awaited before release; a failing fork cancels the body; throws `ConcurrentFailure`.
- `withSaga { saga in try await saga.step { … } compensate: { … } }`.

## Errors
- `withContext("doing X") { … }`, `error.context("…")` → `Report` (root, frames, suppressed, `first(T.self)`); cancellation never wrapped.
- `Defect` (never retried), `PolicyError<F>` (`.rejected(Rejection)` / `.failed(F)`), `Rejection.Reason` (`.deadlineExceeded`, `.cancelled`, `.closed`, `.full`, `.abandonmentLimit`, …), `ConcurrentFailure<F>`.
- `Secret<T>` (`reveal()`), `IdempotencyKey.random()` (create outside retry).

## State machines
- `StateMachine<S, E>(initial:label:) { state, event in .to(next, timeout:) / .stay / .ignore / .invalid("why") }`; `.send(e)`; `.whileIn(state, label:) { sender in … }` (cancelled on exit; stale events dropped); `.states()`.
- `StateGraph.explore(from:events:transition:)`: `.states`, `.invalid`, `.unreachable(of:)`, `.deadEnds`, `.mermaid`.

## Supervision and services
- `Supervisor(label:, strategy: .oneForOne/.oneForAll/.restForOne, intensity:, backoff:) { Child("x", restart: .permanent/.transient/.temporary, heartbeat: .init(interval:)) { heartbeat in … } }`; `try await supervisor.run()`; throws `SupervisorEscalation`.
- `ServiceGraph(label:) { Provide(key, needs: [other.any]) { services in … } stop: { value, exit in … } }`; `try await graph.run { services in … }`; `ServiceKey<T>("name")`.

## Validation
- `StoicJSON`: `JSONDocument(parsing:options:)` (duplicate keys rejected, exact numbers, positions, limits), `JSONValue`, `JSONPath`.
- `StoicSchema`: `Schema.object(T.self, default: T()) { Field("key", \.prop, .double(.range(0...10)), doc:, unit:, aliases:, secret:) }`; `.decode(text)` throws `ValidationFailure` with every issue (path, line:col, did-you-mean); `.decodeReporting(text, options: .lenient)`; `.encode(v, style: .sparse)`; `.jsonSchema()`; `Refined<R>`, `IntRange<lo, hi>`.

## Persistence (StoicStore)
- `AtomicFile(options: .init(keepPrevious: true)).write(bytes, to: path)` (temp, F_FULLFSYNC, rename, directory sync; checksum envelope); `.read(path, validate:)` falls back to `.previous`, quarantines corrupt files.
- `Journal.open(at:)`: framed, checksummed append-only log; `append` durable on return; torn tails cut on open; `compact`.
- `Outbox<Item>.open(at:codec:)`: `enqueue` (durable, assigns an `IdempotencyKey`), `deliverPending { entry in … }` under retry.
- `LaunchGuard(path:).beginLaunch()` → `.normal` / `.safeMode(uncleanLaunches:)`; `markStable(after:)`, `markCleanExit()`.
- `SimulatedFileSystem` + crash-image exploration for crash-consistency tests.

## Observability
- `Ambient.instrumentation` (default OSLog), `Event` (stable names in `EventCatalog`), `RecordingInstrumentation`.

## Testing
- `TestClock` (`advance(by:)`, `waitForSleepers(count:)`), `ImmediateClock` (records sleeps; not for timeouts), `withTestAmbient(clock:seed:events:)`, `@Test(.stoic(seed:))`, `FaultInjector`, `TestGate`.
- `simulate(seeds: 0..<500) { sim in … }`: deterministic simulation. A seed picks every interleaving, time is virtual (`sim.clock` advances when everything sleeps), failures name the seed (`simulate(seed: 137)` replays it), deadlocks are `stalled` with the stuck tasks, livelocks hit `virtualTimeLimit`. The main actor, app-started `Task {}`, Dispatch and real I/O are outside it.
